decision.headline: +$2.55 per 100 shares
decision.call: Small live pilot approved — NOT meaningful capital.

key_finding.rejected: Model-anchored quoting FAILED: −$8–9 per 100sh. Two causes — our Chainlink feed runs ~5s stale (at zero lag markout flips positive), and 33% of model quotes sat ABOVE the market's best bid, i.e. arguing with the book.
key_finding.adopted: Book-mid anchored quoting: quote symmetrically around the order book's own mid. No view, no model, no oracle — which also structurally removes the latency problem, because the book is real-time.

risks.note: 87% of fills sat at levels where depth ahead couldn't be confirmed. Sign survives all 4 queue assumptions, but volume drops sharply under the conservative one.
Backtest assumes the other ~27 pro makers don't react to our presence. In a live book they will.
Live orders go through the REST API; quote-refresh speed is still unmeasured.
15 days, one market regime, no stress event. (The live recorder is now building an out-of-sample window against exactly this.)
79% is below the 85%+ typical of a mature making book; P&L also skews to the back of the sample.
~$184/day at 25-share quotes. Scaling is capped by real order flow arriving at our price levels.
5-min markets sit outside the daily liquidity-rewards pool — the only maker income is 20% of the taker fee on filled size.

next_steps.detail: order signing, live book stream, cancel/replace loop, kill switch
one mid-liquidity market (ETH or SOL), minimum quote size
markout (fair-value drift 30s after fill) as the primary metric
positive markout + stable hit rate → scale gradually; otherwise shut it

notes: Backtest figures are transcribed from the 2026-08-07 study report; recorder figures are read live. Still a promising hypothesis, not a validated business — no capital deployed.
